headline: Fort Hays State put first place beyond reach
dek: Fort Hays State beat Harding to move to 31 points, more than any other side can still reach, and their only dropped points remain the draw at Rogers State. Harding, at the other end, have lost all ten of their conference matches.
displaced_by: Fort Hays State beat Harding, so the standing dek's 28 points and Harding's nine conference defeats are no longer true; the headline's story still holds and the headline stands.
